_note: Class data used by scripts/game.py and the skills. Add a class by adding an entry here (see rules/rules.md section 7 for how abilities are gained).

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.pitch: Tough, brave and hard to knock down. Wears heavy armor and protects friends.

second-wind.name: Second Wind
second-wind.text: As your action, heal 1d10 + your level.

mighty-blow.name: Mighty Blow
mighty-blow.text: Declare before an attack roll: on a hit, roll the weapon's damage dice twice.

shield-wall.name: Shield Wall
shield-wall.text: Until your next turn, you and every ally next to you gain Armor +2 and Resist all +1.

battle-cry.name: Battle Cry
battle-cry.text: As your action: every ally has advantage on their next attack, and Frightened ends for all of you.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: When your melee attack drops an enemy, make a free attack against another enemy next to you.

iron-skin.name: Iron Skin
iron-skin.text: You permanently gain Armor +1 (on top of gear).

unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
unstoppable.text: Instantly end Frozen, Slowed, Stunned or Frightened on yourself, even on the enemy's turn.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.text: As your action, attack every enemy within reach, rolling separately for each.

milestoneIdeas: Titles like the Unbroken, Ironheart, Giant-Feller
A legendary charge that knocks down everything in a line
Refuse to fall: once per day, drop to 1 HP instead of 0
A war shout that makes lesser enemies flee

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.pitch: Quick, sneaky and clever. Picks locks, finds traps and strikes from the shadows.

backpack.name: Thieves' Tools
special: Needed to pick locks and disarm traps

backpack.name: Smoke Bomb
special: Fills an area with smoke; everyone inside becomes Hidden

sneak-attack.name: Sneak Attack
sneak-attack.text: When you attack with advantage, or an ally is next to your target, add 2d6 damage. +1d6 more at levels 5, 10, 15 and so on.

slippery.name: Slippery
slippery.text: Reroll a failed Agility roll and keep the new result.

trap-sense.name: Trap Sense
trap-sense.text: Advantage to spot and disarm traps and pick locks.

shadow-dodge.name: Shadow Dodge
shadow-dodge.text: After you're hit, halve the damage.

poison-blade.name: Poison Blade
poison-blade.text: Coat your blade: your next hit adds 1d6 poison per tier and makes the target Poisoned.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.text: Become Hidden as your action, even while enemies are watching.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.text: Your off-hand weapon adds your Agility to its damage.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.text: Your first attack against an enemy that hasn't noticed you is an automatic critical hit if it lands.

milestoneIdeas: Titles like the Unseen, Quickfingers, Shadowmark
Step through shadows to anywhere you can see
Steal a magical effect or a spell right off an enemy
A strike that ignores all Armor and resistances

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.pitch: Hunter and explorer of the wild. Deadly with a bow, friend to animals, never lost.

hunters-mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters-mark.text: Mark one enemy (free): your attacks against it deal +1d4 damage (+1d4 more per tier) and you always know where it is.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.text: Advantage on tracking, foraging and finding the way. Once per journey, the party may reroll a travel encounter check.

animal-companion.name: Animal Companion
animal-companion.text: A loyal beast (wolf, hawk, boar, lynx…) joins you. It acts on your turn: attack d20 + your Agility, damage 1d6 + tier. It has HP equal to half yours, and it grows with you.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.text: In natural terrain you can become Hidden as your action.

volley.name: Volley
volley.text: As your action, make a ranged attack against up to three different targets.

favored-foe.name: Favored Foe
favored-foe.text: Choose a kind of creature (goblins, undead, dragons…). +2 damage and advantage on Wits checks about them. You can take this again for a new kind.

natures-gift.name: Nature's Gift
natures-gift.text: Learn any two Nature spells. Your Nature spells cost 1 less mana (minimum 1).

rain-of-arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
rain-of-arrows.text: Every enemy in a wide area must dodge (against 10 + your Agility + tier) or take your weapon damage twice.

milestoneIdeas: Titles like Wildheart, the Far-Seeing, Stormarrow
Your companion evolves into a legendary beast (dire wolf, thunder hawk)
An arrow that never misses, once per fight
Speak with every living creature and call the forest to fight

mage.name: Mage
mage.pitch: Master of spells. Fragile, but bends fire, frost, lightning and stranger things to their will.

backpack.name: Spellbook (blank pages)
special: Copy spells you find so you never forget them

elemental-affinity.name: Elemental Affinity
elemental-affinity.text: Choose an element (Fire, Frost, Lightning, Poison, Shadow, Radiant or Arcane). Your spells of that element count as one rank higher. Record your choice in the ability's 'choice' field.

quick-study.name: Quick Study
quick-study.text: Advantage when learning spells from scrolls, and you can identify a magic item's properties by touching it.

mana-surge.name: Mana Surge
mana-surge.text: As a free action, regain mana equal to your level.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.text: When an enemy casts a spell, roll d20 + Magic against its Attack number to cancel it.

spell-shield.name: Spell Shield
spell-shield.text: When you're hit, gain Resist all equal to 2 × your Magic against that hit.

twin-spell.name: Twin Spell
twin-spell.text: Cast a single-target spell on two targets for the cost of one.

arcane-recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
arcane-recovery.text: Short rests restore all your mana instead of half.

second-affinity.name: Second Affinity
second-affinity.text: Choose a second element for Elemental Affinity.

milestoneIdeas: Titles like the Stormcaller, Frostwarden, the Ever-Burning
Combine two spells into one cast
A familiar spirit made of your favourite element
Cast one spell per rest for free at +3 ranks

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.pitch: Holy warrior and healer. Keeps friends alive, protects them, and smites the darkness.

divine-ward.name: Divine Ward
divine-ward.text: As your action, give one ally Resist all 2 (+1 per tier) for the rest of the fight.

turn-undead.name: Turn Undead
turn-undead.text: Every undead nearby must beat 10 + your Magic on d20 + their tier or become Frightened. Weak undead (lower tier) are destroyed.

blessed-healer.name: Blessed Healer
blessed-healer.text: Your healing spells heal extra equal to your Magic.

smite.name: Smite
smite.text: After you hit with a weapon, add 2d6 radiant (+1d6 per tier above 1).

purify.name: Purify
purify.text: As your action, end Poisoned, Burning, Frightened or a curse on one creature.

guardian-spirit.name: Guardian Spirit
guardian-spirit.text: Summon a glowing guardian for the fight. It attacks with d20 + your Magic for 1d8 + tier radiant, and soaks the first hit aimed at an ally.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.text: One ally can't be targeted by attacks until they attack or the round ends.

miracle.name: Miracle
miracle.text: Ask your god for a miracle: restore the whole party to full, bring back a fallen hero, or something just as big.

milestoneIdeas: Titles like Lightbringer, the Merciful, Sunshield
Wings of light: fly and shine like the dawn
A healing wave that also burns enemies
An aura that gives all allies Resist all 2
